title: docs: list MCP servers and prompt-agent tips in the agent guide
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Lists the five MCP server IDs in the `mcpServers` row instead of two examples
- Adds three tips quest submitters kept hitting: `/tmp` is wiped after each Computer call, use literal bash commands with `stdin`, and identical requests are served from cache during testing
- Companion: the three code-agent example repos now point at production instead of staging (READMEs and workflow names updated directly)

Addresses #14821 #14822 #14823

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Agent guide, less haunted
gist.blurb: The agent guide now names all five MCP servers and documents three small gotchas that have been eating quest submissions for breakfast. A few fewer mysteries in the garden shed.
gist.summary: Updated BUILD_YOUR_OWN_AGENT.md to list all five MCP server IDs, explain that /tmp resets after every Computer call, recommend literal bash commands via stdin, and note that identical test requests are cache-served; the companion code-agent examples now target production rather than staging.
gist.impact: Agent builders and Quest submitters can configure the full MCP set and avoid lost temporary files, malformed shell calls, and confusing cached test results while following production-ready examples.
gist.visual_concept: Polli wears tiny guide glasses and points at a cozy retro terminal displaying five glowing MCP server badges, while a small paper note labeled '/tmp' gently dissolves between Computer-call icons. Code-plants, a stdin command scroll, and a cache jar make the practical guide tips visible without making the scene feel like a warning label.
